title: Crane up
purpose: The camera rises through the shot and the world's verticals swing with it. Where the camera IS, changing, rather than fixed for the whole take.
keeps: the swing, arithmetic per frame, inside a zoom so nothing outside the frame is asked for
the angle at the end, measured on the last frame
cannot: the parallax of a real crane (the depth map belongs to the plate; by the time a take exists there is no depth per frame, so this is a boom on a locked head)
much travel on a plate that is already steeply angled - a keystone replaces a vanishing point rather than adding to it, so there is less room the further it starts
measured: asked +0.45 from a plate already at +0.50 delivered +0.22; asked -0.70 from +0.40 delivered -0.76; direction correct 4 of 4
